title: Being an open morphism is fppf local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that openness of a morphism is fppf local on the source (statement lines 7065-7069). The proof checks the clauses of the chapter's general criterion for locality on the source: Zariski locality on source and target is clear, preservation under composition is the standard lemma, a flat morphism of finite presentation is open, and the descent clause (4) is the fpqc quotient topology statement; the criterion then gives the result (proof lines 7071-7081). The level is H2: the verification is short, but the four clauses are each identified and matched to their input rather than merely asserted.
